nodes.name: build.gradle
nodes.summary: Root Android Gradle build configuration that declares build plugins and repositories, loads shared version variables, and provides the project clean task.
nodes.languageNotes: Groovy Gradle configuration shared across the Android project.

nodes.name: capacitor.settings.gradle
nodes.summary: Generated Capacitor settings fragment that registers the native bridge and installed Android plugin modules with the Gradle project graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Declarative Gradle module inclusion generated for Capacitor plugins.

nodes.name: gradle.properties
nodes.summary: Project-wide Gradle properties controlling build-process JVM behavior and AndroidX compatibility for the native Android build.

nodes.name: gradlew.bat
nodes.summary: Windows Gradle wrapper launcher that resolves the project directory and Java runtime, invokes the pinned wrapper bootstrap, forwards command-line arguments, and propagates its exit status.
nodes.languageNotes: Conventional Windows batch control flow with labeled setup, execution, and failure paths.

nodes.name: settings.gradle
nodes.summary: Android Gradle settings entry point that assembles the application, Capacitor bridge, and generated plugin settings into one multi-module build.

nodes.name: variables.gradle
nodes.summary: Centralized Android build-version catalog for SDK levels and the AndroidX, Firebase, Cordova, unit-test, and instrumentation-test dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Groovy extra properties keep native dependency versions consistent across modules.
